caption: The drawing depicts a single oval-shaped lidded container positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The container itself is rendered in shades of brown, resembling copper or a similar metal. The lid has a smooth, rounded surface with slight highlights and darker areas suggesting a metallic sheen. At the center of the lid, there is a circular knob handle in a golden-brown color, attached by a short stem. A large, ornate metallic piece in a grayish-silver hue is fixed to the lid, curving around the base of the knob and spreading outward symmetrically. The container's body is plain, matching the coloring and finish of the lid, with two subtle parallel ridges running around its circumference. No other objects or features are present in the composition, and there are no additional colors besides the browns and metallic grays of the container and the off-white background.
title: Bed Warmer
